text:
DeployBot: [auto] attempted publish repo=redwood/sidecar image=sidecar:20260321-xyz789 -> FAILED provenance check: signature timestamp out-of-range for gcr artifact; quarantined.
jen: saw alert on paging. Can someone confirm this is a signing time skew and not GCR clock?
sam: quick look: cosign signature exists but timestamp is 2026-03-21T02:12:03Z, provenance policy expects <= 5m skew. our attestor rejected due to 8m skew.
linda: hmm CI-runner (build-12) had a recent restart during NTP drift window per infra logs. likely culprit.
infra-bot: recent events: NTP sync reschedule on build-12 at 02:05Z -> drift corrected at 02:14Z.
ops-team: confirmed NTP drift on runner. short term options: 1) re-sign artifact (fast) 2) pin canary to previous attested digest and hold 3) rollback full deploy.
release-coordinator: change window 45m. Product owners prefer minimal user impact; re-sign preferred if safe. Need checklist for re-sign.
jen: agreed re-sign, but we must ensure signing key uses approved KMS key and that audit logs capture re-sign. Also update release notes.
sam: plan: pull manifest + image from GCR, run cosign sign with KMS key versions (use key version v3), push an updated attestation artifact, then update manifest list. Commands I will run:
```
# fetch manifest
gcloud artifacts docker images describe gcr.io/redwood/sidecar:20260321-xyz789 --project=redwood --format=json > manifest.json
# sign
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prov/cryptoKeys/attest-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3 gcr.io/redwood/sidecar:20260321-xyz789
# verify
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prov/cryptoKeys/attest-key gcr.io/redwood/sidecar:20260321-xyz789
```
ops-team: note: key v3 has rotation constraints; usage at current rate ok. I'll temporarily bump KMS IAM policy to allow CI-service-account to sign from build-ops group while we refresh runner config.
infra-bot: runner (build-12) has been quarantined from accepting new builds; recommend re-run sign from control node instead of ephemeral runner to avoid repeat skew.
linda: i'll copy artifact to control node and perform sign. also will snapshot audit logs to releases bucket: gs://redwood-releases/audit/20260321-sidecar-re-sign.log
jen: ensure the release board knows: if re-sign completes, we promote arm64/arm pools; if it fails we pin canary to previous digest and open rollback.
sam: starting sign on control node now. posting cosign output when done.
ops-team: KMS IAM temp policy applied (+ci-runner-sign). revert scheduled in 15m.
sam: cosign sign completed; verify output:
```
Verification for gcr.io/redwood/sidecar:20260321-xyz789 -- OK
```
sam: pushed attestation blob and refreshed manifest list. GCR now shows attestation timestamp 2026-03-21T02:18:12Z within allowed window.
DeployBot: publish guard re-check passed; image moved out of quarantine. canary promotion unlocked for sidecar.
release-coordinator: promoting to canary pools now, monitoring 10m for error increase and resource metrics.
linda: updated release notes draft: "2026-03-21: sidecar image re-signed to correct provenance timestamp after builder NTP drift; no code changes. CI runner NTP fix scheduled."
jen: filing infra ticket to enforce NTP monitoring & add a signing preflight check in CI (cosign verify timestamp) to catch early.
ops-team: KMS policy revert completed.
infra-bot: scheduled job: run `ntpstat` on runners every 5m and annotate builds with ntp-offset header. (ticket INF-2026-44)
jen: all good; closing thread unless canary shows anomalies. thanks team. :tada:
DeployBot: thread auto-closed after successful promote and no alerts.
